roads.name: North Kings Highway
words: Properly twisty: 16 curves in 2.0 miles, about 8 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 290 to 385 ft, with 300 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.77 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Joy Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 10 curves in 3.1 miles.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 414 to 487 ft, with 258 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.18 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
